name: Elias Monroe

signature.name: Full Hands
signature.description: For 5 seconds, every attuned echo in his loadout runs at once at full fidelity, ignoring slot count and stamina reservation — the screen fills with everyone he's let in. Then every free thread drops.

branches.name: Capacity
branches.theme: free slots, class permissions, reservation, palette duration (docs/02 §1.8)

nodes.name: Stance Permission
nodes.effect: Stance-class echoes may run on a thread

nodes.name: Field Permission
nodes.effect: Field-class echoes may run on a thread

branches.name: Echo Fidelity
branches.theme: echo strength = source hero's bond level through the fidelity curve; nodes raise the floor and push the cap to 120% (docs/02 §1.8 — replaces "Library")

nodes.name: Truer Than the Original
nodes.effect: Fidelity cap → 120% — he's had time to listen

branches.name: Braids
branches.theme: two running echoes braided into one composite effect occupying both slots; recipes are data rows keyed to source-move pairs — naming and flavor per pairing owned by docs/04 (docs/02 §1.8)

nodes.name: Clean Weave
nodes.effect: Braided composites ignite for 30 power instead of 40

nodes.name: Tight Wrap
nodes.effect: Braided composites reserve regen as 1.5 threads, not 2

nodes.name: Living Knot
nodes.effect: Braids inherit the HIGHER of the two source fidelities

nodes.name: Full Braid Is Dead, Long Live Full Hands
nodes.effect: During Full Hands, all valid braid composites fire too

personality.summary: Steady under load — the man you want holding the door; dry Minnesota deflection as a first language; and a guilt he has built an entire functioning life around, which the game slowly makes load-bearing. He shows up, he counts exits, and he lies only by omission — the specific omission being the plot.

aiRules: AI Anchor keeps echoes running and never lights new ones (docs/02 §1.8).
When stamina-starved, AI Anchor drops the highest-reservation echo first (docs/02 §1.8).
Progression: combat XP and story beats only — no bond-XP spigot on yourself (docs/02 §1.8/§2.2).
